Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Discover the opportunity to make impactful decisions and collaborate across multiple groups to drive success. You will manage and engage with various teams, contributing to key decisions and providing effective solutions to challenges that arise. This role will embrace expertise in API Testing, Backend Testing, and Test Automation to foster innovation and continuous improvement. Join us in shaping a dynamic environment where your insights and collaboration will be highly valued and celebrated.
Design and execute API, backend, integration, and regression tests to ensure high-quality software delivery.
Develop and maintain automated tests and contribute to the enhancement of automation frameworks using Playwright, Karate, and BDD practices.
Analyze test failures, identify defects, and support root-cause analysis to drive quality improvements.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless testing within the delivery lifecycle.
Continuously contribute to QA processes, test management, defect traceability, and continuous improvement initiatives while supporting and mentoring junior QA engineers.
 HERE'S WHAT YOU WILL NEED:
Expert proficiency in API and Backend Testing.
A minimum of 6 years of experience in test automation and quality engineering.
Hands-on experience with Playwright, Karate, and Cucumber/BDD frameworks.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP protocols, and system integrations.
Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field of studies.
 BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:
Expert proficiency in System Defect Management and Root Cause Analysis.
Expert proficiency in Technical Test Execution and Test Automation Frameworks.
Advanced proficiency in Test Planning and Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
Intermediate proficiency in Jira/Xray, Confluence, and test traceability management.
Beginner proficiency in Continuous Integration using Jenkins, Bitbucket/Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with SQL/database testing, microservices, distributed systems, Docker, cloud environments, and programming languages such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python.
 Join us for a fulfilling career and a balanced lifestyle that celebrates diversity and promotes inclusivity.
